name: Kuonji Ukyou
source: Ranma's childhood friend, nicknamed "Ucchan" by him. After transferring to Furinkan High School, she reunites with Ranma a decade later. A skilled okonomiyaki chef, she has run her own shop since childhood. She also harbors a feeling for Ranma.
